title: BLS powers-of-tau k33: stored x2 + p and exact round share on the k32 batch-round walk (F=999/1000)

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 powers-of-tau target, the complete paired class-walk algorithm and argument supplied here has W(2^20)<=2^116.156200607612276 reference units at C=2000 and success>=0.39 conditional on explicitly disclosed H1-H5 in source-proof.md with H4 restated as the per-class pair-fraction floor F=999/1000 of proof.md section 16. It uses only A_1 and A_(2^20), and the same W(n) bound holds for 2^20<=n<r. Preprocessing, failure/cap work, communication, verification, recovery included. Total memory<2^122.0004 bytes, preprocessing<2^115.1707 units and included, no advice. Analytical conditional bound, not a production execution. Section 26: no reference addition in the walk; per round one executed batch listing (Montgomery's trick on the shipped product body, s15 Fermat inversion; 925 instructions per lane op with x2 + p stored in each gap-table entry, section 27) feeds two calls of the measured kernel, P-T on pair lanes and P+T on all lanes by its 9-offset variant on the negated entry (pair 2805+s for two points, root 1875+s, s = 172584/2^18 the exact round share, section 27). Section 1: 929-instruction kernel (K1, K2), Callgrind-measured, 24 paths, 509-lane audit also run on the variant, 40 per invocation (s20); s2: coverage target 0.49511789492; s11-12: caps 1.00001/1.000031 x mean; s9-12, s17-25: record path listings, executed transport pair loops; s16: per-class floor F = 999/1000, checked per class; s15: exact restart price SMX 630722, executed end to end.

experiments.purpose: Recompute amended ledger + exact log ceiling; rerun the planner (greedy + s16 augmentation; per-class pair fractions, capped and uncapped), transport/toy evidence, parity-key checks, the word-level kernel audit of measure/side_lanes.S and of its s26 P+T variant (path enumeration, 509 lanes, stride-128 footprint), the executed s26 batch round with both side calls, the K1 carry-bound witness and the record-path audits (s17 packed layout, s18-25 asserts, executed INS22/LOOK10 pairs). Finite evidence only.
